hero.headline: FootPal FC runs on a 27-model Postgres schema, 109 route handlers, and 175 tests.
hero.subheadline: It organizes recurring pickup soccer for 25+ players across three crews — RSVPs, team drafting, cost splitting, and player ratings.
hero.bio: I'm a full-stack developer and a Computer Engineering graduate from York University (2025), based in the GTA. I work in TypeScript, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, and Python, and I've shipped two products to people who aren't me: FootPal FC, which I've been building since June 2026, and KonnectTaps, a digital business card platform I co-founded and built the frontend for. Most of what I care about as an engineer is in the decisions below — what I chose, and what it cost.

projects.title: FootPal FC
projects.description: Organizes recurring pickup soccer — RSVPs, team drafting, cost splitting, and player ratings — across independent crews. In use by 25+ players in three crews, two of them outside my own friend circle (Montreal and Mississauga). Building since June 2026.

projects.title: KonnectTaps
projects.description: Digital business card platform I co-founded and built the frontend for, working with two other developers. Reached 100+ signups. Wound down in May 2026.

projects.title: SOSO — Satellite Operations Services Optimizer
projects.description: Canadian Space Agency capstone. I built the React dashboard visualizing satellite telemetry and orbital pass schedules for CSA stakeholders, and authored the system documentation and design trade-off analysis.
